wake.speaker: tomas
wake.text: Oh. I thought I heard you moving.

wake.speaker: caelan
wake.text: That was me trying to get comfortable.

wake.speaker: tomas
wake.text: *a small laugh* Well, get uncomfortable. Mother’s already sent me up once.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: Where do you want the tables tomorrow, Mother? Same place as last year?

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Along the courtyard wall, I think. Leave the way from the gate clear.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: We could put one nearer the kitchen door. Save everyone carrying dishes so far.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Yes, that would help. Show me where you mean after breakfast.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: And when we’re finished, could I go over to Mira’s?

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: What are you working on?

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: Nothing yet. I want to ask her about the arm brace. I can follow each linkage on its own, but I can’t work out how they help her lift without getting in the way of her hand.

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: You could ask her to slow him down.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: I did. She started explaining, and then someone brought her a broken hinge.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: She’ll be busy today. Ask whether she has time before you settle in.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: I will.

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: Will you need me all afternoon?

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: I need some help this morning. What did you have in mind?

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: I wanted to practise my magicks. Down by the brook, perhaps.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: You had your book out last night.

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: I know.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: I wasn’t complaining.

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: *a little embarrassed* No. I just keep going back to the same part.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Is there something in it you don’t understand?

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: It makes sense when I read it. Then I try, and I can’t tell whether I’ve misunderstood something or whether I simply need more practice.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Would you like someone with you?

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: For now, I’d rather try on my own.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: All right. We’ll leave you some time this afternoon.

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: Thank you.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: You can leave the tables to me once we’ve carried them out. I can arrange them.

breakfast.speaker: caelan
breakfast.text: All right.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Eat another piece before you go, both of you. Tomorrow’s the Festival of Light; today I expect we’ll all forget to stop for lunch.

breakfast.speaker: tomas
breakfast.text: I won’t.

breakfast.speaker: serene
breakfast.text: Then remind the rest of us.

books.label: bookshelf
books.text: Two chapters left. I keep telling myself I'll finish them before festival week.

notes.label: desk notes
notes.text: Copies of the old local inscriptions. Serene says they're easier to read once I stop adding my own guesses.

drawing.label: family drawing
drawing.text: Tomas insisted that's me. I'm still not sure why he gave me such enormous ears.

window.label: window
window.text: Eldenmere's already awake. It smells like somebody started baking before sunrise.

acceptance.speaker: serene
acceptance.text: Thank you. Then Elira and the Venns in whichever order suits you.

acceptance.speaker: tomas
acceptance.text: Am I coming for all three?

acceptance.speaker: serene
acceptance.text: Come back after Halden. You and I can get those courtyard tables into place.

acceptance.speaker: caelan
acceptance.text: I said I’d help with those.

acceptance.speaker: tomas
acceptance.text: We can manage. You’ve got the other visits.

acceptance.speaker: caelan
acceptance.text: All right. Take the smaller bundle, then. I’ll carry the rest.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: serene
breakfast_greeting.text: Good morning, Caelan. There’s bread beside your brother. Help yourself.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: caelan
breakfast_greeting.text: Morning. Sorry—I didn’t mean to sleep so late.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: serene
breakfast_greeting.text: You haven’t missed anything. Sit down.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: tomas
breakfast_greeting.text: Most of it. There are still the tables to move.

breakfast_greeting.speaker: tomas
breakfast_greeting.text: Good. I wasn’t going to try them on my own.

kindness.speaker: serene
kindness.text: When you’ve finished, come and see me. There are a few things I’d like taken into the village.
